name: chat_resource
reportModel:
<#list data as item>

<#if item.name??>
标题 ${item.name}
</#if>

<#if item.publish_name??>
发布人 ${item.publish_name}
</#if>

<#if item.publish_time??>
发布时间 ${item.publish_time}
</#if>

<#if item.publish_content??>
发布内容 ${item.publish_content}
</#if>


<#assign comments = api.invoke("/article_pages/"+item.id+"/comments/fetch_default",'{"n_owner_type_eq":"PAGE","n_principal_id_eq":"'+item.id+'","page":0,"size":1000}') >
<#if comments?has_content>
评论
	<#list comments as comment>
	${comment.create_man!""}于${comment.create_time!""}发表
		<#if comment.pcontent??>
		> ${comment.pcontent}
		</#if>
		${utils.html2md(comment.content!"")}
	</#list>
</#if>

</#list>
